diagnosis.root_cause: The subscriber's CATV service is provisioned but the ONU CATV receiver is not synchronized (catv_synced=0), while Internet service, EPON optics, authentication, VLAN 1037, and shared PON infrastructure are healthy.
evidence: The complaint concerns TV only; Internet traffic is active and stable.
The subscriber is active, has CATV capability and service enabled, and uses the CATV profile.
catv_synced=0 directly indicates that the CATV receiver is not synchronized.
EPON status is online with normal RX power (-20.4 dBm), normal TX power (2.45 dBm), stable seven-day optics, constant distance, and healthy TX bias current.
All tested peers on EPON0/7 are online with normal optical readings, so there is no shared PON, splitter, port, or OLT fault.
The OLT responds to ping and SNMP, with normal CPU, memory, and temperature; the router heartbeat is also healthy.
RADIUS authentication and line-ID mapping are consistent, sessions are at the normal baseline, and there is no evidence of authentication flapping.
The expected customer VLAN 1037 is present and matches the actual VLAN, ruling out the VLAN46 provisioning fault.
The remaining evidence is isolated to the CATV service path, best represented by catv_drift.

remediation.action: Check the CATV/RF optical level and physical coaxial connections at the subscriber premises, including splitters and connectors; verify CATV signal delivery to the ONU, restart or resynchronize the CATV receiver, and replace the ONU or RF component if synchronization cannot be restored.

ground_truth.root_cause: The customer is recorded as subscribed to CATV but catv_synced is 0, so the CATV state was never pushed to the ONU. Data service is unaffected; only the television service is missing.
expected_reasoning: The customer reports working internet and missing television
catv_service is 1 and catv_synced is 0, so the subscription exists and the device state does not match it
The ONU model supports CATV, so this is not an equipment limitation
Optical readings are normal and the live probe confirms the ONU is healthy
Sessions and daily traffic are normal, consistent with working data service
The OLT and router are healthy and no shared fault exists
This is a service state mismatch on one dimension, of the same class as the 84 unsynced lines in the estate
It is resolved by re-pushing the CATV state rather than by any field work
distractors: Every network signal is healthy, inviting a no_fault conclusion
The complaint could be read as customer equipment rather than provisioning
